assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are maintainer-defined provisional geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, alignments and phasing must be recalculated after official polygons are issued.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines and facility standards are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development-intensity claim is made; all such metrics remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, condition, ownership and occupancy surveys are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are reversible interface prototypes; retain/retrofit/demolish decisions are not made.

assumptions.statement: Official road, railway, metro, bridge, fire access and parking engineering data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The spine and seven thresholds are conceptual desire lines requiring safety and engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Complete heritage protection boundaries and view controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Cultural interventions are reversible and avoid claims about protected-building modification.

assumptions.statement: Utility, drainage, flood, energy, telecom and underground-space data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge compute, canopies, rain gardens and night lighting require utility and resilience checks.

assumptions.statement: Public-ground access is proposed as step-free, time-zoned and supported by non-digital fallback.
assumptions.impact: Opening hours and access rights require property and operations agreements; the proposal does not claim legal easements.

assumptions.statement: The 52-week calendar and stewardship model are reference mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: They do not commit government budgets, operators, event approvals or delivery dates.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are used for mechanism comparison, not direct spatial transplantation.
assumptions.impact: Local adoption requires Chinese law, climate, governance and public-interest review.

assumptions.statement: COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY is retained from the template because no repository-wide licence or full custom legal text was found.
assumptions.impact: Confirm its legal meaning in writing before publication or select a Creative Commons option explicitly.
